title: The question-form check refuses a page question whose only change is a widening form
why: Incident, 2026-11-07 15:38 CST: triage put item 376 on the page. Its only change from main was a widening option, and decision uniform-over-variants already rules that the shared tool never grows a second form. The coordinator withdrew it at 15:41 CST. The owner saw a question a ruling answers.
note: In hooks/question_form.py: when every option but the recommended one sets widens:true, refuse with 'uniform-over-variants decides this; take the non-widening option'. Done check: item 376's shape is red, and a question with two non-widening options passes. The check's verdict changes, so this is a build lane.
